Executes full PrefMaX workflow

run_prefmax.Rd

Executes full PrefMaX workflow

Usage

run_prefmax(
  path,
  file,
  ShortID = NULL,
  sheet_liking = NULL,
  sheet_products = NULL,
  sheet_subjects = NULL,
  scale.unit = FALSE,
  ncp = 2,
  nb.clust = NULL,
  max.clust = 6,
  scale_desc = 1,
  scale_subj = 1,
  label_consumers = FALSE,
  output_dir = getwd(),
  res_dpi = 300,
  save_tiff = TRUE,
  sheet_hedo = NULL,
  sheet_qda = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

path

Input directory.

file

Input Excel filename.

ShortID

Short identifier string.

sheet_liking

Sheet with liking data.

sheet_products

Sheet with product data.

sheet_subjects

Sheet with subject data.

scale.unit

Standardize product variables in PCA.

ncp

Dimensions count.

nb.clust

Forced cluster count.

max.clust

Max cluster search.

scale_desc

Descriptor scaling.

scale_subj

Subject variables scaling.

label_consumers

Display consumer labels.

output_dir

Output directory path.

res_dpi

Resolution DPI for TIFF.

save_tiff

Export TIFF files.

sheet_hedo

Legacy alias for sheet_liking.

sheet_qda

Legacy alias for sheet_products.

...

Additional arguments.

Value

A list with PrefMaX execution results and plots.
